name: lume
description: Lumé — an editorial skin, style, and try-on companion powered by Perfect Corp YouCam APIs.

scripts.dev: node api.js && concurrently -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: node api.js && npm run build -w client && mkdir -p dist && cp -r client/dist/. dist/
scripts.start: node api.js && npm run start -w server
